scope: Windows physical keyboard and mouse routed by screen edges to a paired Mac and back to Windows
implemented: Authenticated remote display inventory with native monitor identities
Native layout editor binds every local and remote monitor to actual geometry
Explicit application of an immutable layout snapshot and manual enabling
Absolute positioning bound to the target Mac display ID
Ordered keyboard, buttons and wheel input following remote cursor focus
Windows local delivery suppression while remote focus is active
Return to local screen releases remote ownership and clears local suppression
Unexpected connection or queue epoch changes revoke routing, including a reconnect between geometry calculation and queue commit
Display change, Windows session lock and suspension stop capture

windows_validation.automatic_window_click: unavailable: coordinate input geometry is unavailable
windows_validation.sandbox_test_note: Isolated DPAPI/file-commit tests require host execution; restricted execution failures were rerun successfully.

review_fixes: Trace previous native position when an arranged remote monitor sits between two physically adjacent Windows monitors
Do not apply a native movement packet twice when it has only just reached an edge
Validate the complete current monitor set, not only previously configured bindings
Compare queue connection epoch under the same lock used to commit handoff
